question: ﻿Which scheme was launched by Indian government for creation of self employment opportunities for unemployed educated youth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana** (PMRY) was launched by the **Indian government in 1993 **to create **self-employment opportunities **for **unemployed youth,** including educated youth.
 
• The scheme aimed to provide **financial assistance** to set up **small businesses or industries**, with a focus on the urban and rural poor.
 
• The scheme provided a maximum loan of **Rs. 2 lakhs** (now increased to Rs. 25 lakhs) at a concessional rate of interest to eligible beneficiaries.
 
• The beneficiaries were required to contribute a **small margin money **(5-10% of the project cost) and **undergo training **in **entrepreneurship development.**
 
• PMRY was merged with another scheme called the **Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme** (PMEGP) in** 2008,** which is currently being implemented by the **Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Rural Employment Guarantee Act **(NREGA) is a social welfare scheme that guarantees **100 days of wage employment** per year to rural households whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
• **Annapurna scheme** is a **food security scheme **that provides food grains to eligible senior citizens who are unable to fend for themselves.
 
• **Grameen Udyami Yojana **is a scheme for providing **credit to rural entrepreneurs**, especially women, for setting up small businesses and industries.
